WITH RECURSIVE json_keys AS (
    SELECT 'shipment_overview' as path, k, v 
    FROM shipments, jsonb_each(shipment_overview) as j(k, v)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT jk.path || '.' || sub.k, sub.k, sub.v
    FROM json_keys jk,
         LATERAL (SELECT key as k, value as v FROM jsonb_each(jk.v::jsonb)) sub
    WHERE jk.v::text LIKE '{%' AND length(jk.path) < 100
)
SELECT DISTINCT path, k FROM json_keys ORDER BY path, k;
